title: Optimized local variables are not recoverable at certain instruction locations
summary: Variables can exist in registers, constants, or within a range of locations, or they can be eliminated; the debugger will report optimized out.
applies: Offline stack traceback, symbol matching and debugging information for native programs
detail: Even if there is debugging information, the same local quantity can be displayed in the previous section but not in the next section.
boundary: Reporting unrecoverability does not prove that variables were zero at runtime; nor does recompiling variable locations replace old dumps.
relevance: Distinguish between missing source-level variables and anomalies in actual program values.
